definitions.supplemental: O. H. Ger. citawar, zitwar : Ger. zitwer : Low Lat. zedoaria, zeduarium (v. hoc zeduarium zeduarye, Wrt. Voc. i. 227, col. 1) from Arabic zedwár. From a French form citoual comes Mid. E. zeduale, A. R. 370, 11, cete&dash-uncertain;wale. Chauc. Group B 1951, see Skeat's note on the passage.
